ledger: dancer's feet | both feet planted flat in wide stance on studio floor at 00:00 | right foot supporting weight, left foot pointed on floor at 00:09 | slight weight shifts and foot pivoting between 00:02 and 00:05 with solid floor contact maintained

dancer's arms | right arm extending outward, left arm resting down by left side at 00:00 | right arm curved overhead, left arm resting by left side at 00:09 | right arm raises overhead (00:01), warps/switches sides abnormally (00:02), lowers (00:03-00:05), and sweeps back overhead (00:06-00:09)

findings.description: As the dancer holds her right arm overhead at 00:01, her limb configuration snaps impossibly at 00:02: the raised right arm disappears from her right shoulder and an upright arm extends from her left shoulder instead while a segment of her tattooed left forearm remains at her waist, before snapping back to a raised right arm and lowered left arm at 00:03.
